source.title: Applications for Continental Championships 2024 (September 2023)
source.content:
The Board of Directors would like to receive applications for the following regions for Continental Championships 2024:

*  Africa
*  Asia
*  Oceania

Please discuss with the Delegates in your country whether this is something you are willing and able to pursue. Bear in mind that organizing a competition of this size takes a significant amount of time and effort before and during the competition.

If you are interested, send your application documents privately to board@worldcubeassociation.org before October 31st, 2023, 23:59 UTC. Documents must be sent in PDF format in two versions: one full version with all the details for the application, and another version with sensitive details - if any - removed to make public.
<!-- break -->

Please include in your application documents at least the following information:

When would you like to hold the Championship?
1a. Possible dates
1b. Number of days of the competition.
1c. Overlap with international holiday periods of schools.

Where would you like to hold the Championship in your country?
2a. City should be interesting to visit for foreigners with opportunities for sightseeing.
2b. Ease of international, national, and local travel.
2c. Availability of hotels/apartments with different price categories.
2d. Venue, venue size, and venue setup (stage, audience, tables to practice, side rooms).
2e. Technology available like the internet, video streaming, lighting, sound equipment.
2f. Number of competitors and spectators that can be hosted.

What would the organization team and staff look like?
3a. Core team members.
3b. Experience of the core team.
3c. Involvement of other parties.
3d. Quantity and quality of local volunteers (guideline is 20% of competitors should staff).
3e. Required support by foreign Delegates.

What would be the overall budget for the competition?
4a. Cost (venue, venue services, stage, equipment, decorations, website, badges/lanyards/giftpacks, prizes).
4b. Income (registration fees, sponsoring, local government).

[Here](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w6uxOHrr40of1R4-NjU1vy7fVJXRHiRZBn53Hc-IOk8/edit#gid=455356503) is an example document with a non-exhaustive list of topics that need to be arranged and budgeted for a large competition. Please note with regards to the budgeting section that we are currently finalizing plans for a sponsor to contribute a significant amount to these championships. When available, the details will be communicated to the selected teams.  

Once the application period is over, the WCA Board of Directors will interview applicants, consult other WCA Staff members, and vote in order to decide where the Championships will take place. If any Director is involved in a team that sends in an application, they will be replaced in the selection process by another person (for example a Senior Delegate or a Committee/Team Leader).

We are looking for competitions that can reinforce our concept of large WCA competitions, boosting the professionalization of our organization and able to offer the competitors the best possible experience and the world the best possible show.

Thank you in advance for your cooperation and we look forward to viewing your applications!

translation.title: 2024 年大洲锦标赛申办（2023 年 9 月）
translation.content:
董事会现征集以下地区的 2024 年大洲锦标赛申办方案：

* 非洲
* 亚洲
* 大洋洲

请与本国代表商议，确定是否有意愿和能力申办。请注意，举办这一规模的比赛，无论赛前还是赛中，都需要投入大量时间和精力。

有意者请于 2023 年 10 月 31 日 23:59 UTC 前，将申请材料私下发送至 board@worldcubeassociation.org。材料须为 PDF 格式，提供两个版本：包含全部申办细节的完整版，以及删去敏感信息（如有）、可供公开的版本。

<!-- break -->

申请材料至少应包含以下信息：

计划何时举办锦标赛？

- 1a. 可选日期。
- 1b. 比赛天数。
- 1c. 是否与各国学校假期重合。

计划在贵国的什么地点举办锦标赛？

- 2a. 城市应对外国游客具有吸引力，并提供观光机会。
- 2b. 国际、国内及市内交通的便利程度。
- 2c. 不同价位酒店或公寓的供应情况。
- 2d. 场馆、面积及布置（舞台、观众区、练习桌、附属房间）。
- 2e. 可用技术设施，如网络、视频直播、灯光和音响设备。
- 2f. 可容纳的选手与观众人数。

组织团队和工作人员如何安排？

- 3a. 核心团队成员。
- 3b. 核心团队的经验。
- 3c. 其他参与方。
- 3d. 当地志愿者的数量与能力（建议有 20% 的选手参与工作人员工作）。
- 3e. 需要国外代表提供哪些支持。

比赛的总预算如何安排？

- 4a. 支出：场地、场馆服务、舞台、设备、装饰、网站、证件/挂绳/礼包及奖品。
- 4b. 收入：报名费、赞助、当地政府支持。

[这份示例文件](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w6uxOHrr40of1R4-NjU1vy7fVJXRHiRZBn53Hc-IOk8/edit#gid=455356503)列出了大型比赛需要安排和纳入预算的部分事项，并非完整清单。关于预算部分，请注意，我们正在敲定一项赞助计划，拟由赞助商为这些锦标赛提供较大金额的支持。细节确定后，将告知获选团队。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将与申请方进行面谈，征求其他 WCA 工作人员的意见，并通过投票决定举办地。如有董事参与某个申办团队，该董事将在遴选过程中由其他人替代，例如高级代表或委员会/团队负责人。

我们希望这些比赛能够进一步体现大型 WCA 比赛的理念，推动组织更加专业地运作，为选手提供尽可能好的参赛体验，也向全世界呈现尽可能精彩的赛事。

感谢大家的配合，期待收到你们的申办方案！
